comments.body: Reproduced independently on 2026-11-04 while verifying upset-prissy-olm. make verify's integration tier crashed xdist worker gw2 on test_benchmark_commit_count_is_ceil_per_pass. Run alone: 307.5 s wall (user 15.8 s, sys 28.3 s) on the branch, and 306.9 s (user 13.3 s, sys 23.5 s) on its parent e0ab18822c6 (origin/main), both rc=1 at the 300 s timeout, load average 30-36. The test times out with or without the opcert change, and wall time far exceeds CPU time, which is consistent with waiting on child processes.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

`tests/interfaces/io/test_import_batch_resume.py::test_benchmark_commit_count_is_ceil_per_pass` (integration tier, n=3000 tickets with 1 comment each) hit the 300 s pytest-timeout on 2026-11-04 on a macOS host at load average 25-33. That happened twice: once in `make verify`'s integration tier (xdist worker gw2 "node down: Not properly terminated"), and again when run alone.

The timeout stack was in import's comment pass: `rebar._io.import_ndjson.import_tickets` (line 290) -> `rebar._lib_mutations.comment` (line 74) -> `emit_cross_session_warning` (`src/rebar/_lib_warn.py:59`) -> `cross_session_warning_for` (`src/rebar/_commands/cross_session.py:54`) -> `show_ticket` -> `_reads._fresh` -> `ensure_fresh` (`src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:221`), waiting on a `git` child.

`ensure_fresh` spawns `git rev-parse --verify <branch>` before it checks its 60 s marker throttle, so every comment imported pays a full ticket read plus at least 1 git child process for an advisory cross-session warning. On an import of n comments that is n extra processes, and the cost scales with host load.

The comment path has existed since 2026-08-27 (`65208a7ef81`, `6d95718080c`). It was found while verifying `quartzitic-deathful-needletail`, whose change touches only `tests/unit/test_mcp_gate_async.py`.

## Next check

Count the git child processes per imported comment (a Popen counter around `rebar.import_tickets` with n=50). Then compare against an import with the cross-session warning disabled, to test whether the warning read accounts for the per-comment process cost.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The git child-process count for importing n comments is measured and recorded on this ticket, with and without the cross-session warning read.
- [ ] Importing n comments does not start a git child process per comment for the cross-session warning; verified by a test that counts Popen calls during a small import.
compiled_state.title: Import comment pass starts a git process per comment for the cross-session warning
